data.gender_notes: Pravina is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pravina is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pravin', which means 'progress' or 'advancement'. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and spirituality, representing the journey of life and the continuous progress towards enlightenment. The name Pravina carries the meaning “Progress, Advancement” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pravina usually hope their child will grow to embody progress, advancement and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pravina total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
